title: Classic dashboard
summary: Hex panels, glow, scan lines, MAGI
description: A cyan command board of hexagonal panels. A central unit wireframe sits beside a waveform, the MAGI triad is marked active, and a warning band runs under scan-line glow.

title: Grid layout
description: Command-center grid of chamfered panels. A radar scan and activity readout share the board with three MAGI online badges and a small isometric interior.

title: Blueprint
summary: Full-body wireframe, PCB traces, subtle glow
description: Blueprint treatment of EVA-01. A full-body wireframe, GEO FRONT radar, and faint circuit traces sit under a quiet glow, with Melchior, Balthasar, and Casper in separate pills.

title: Orange alert
summary: Hex MAGI cluster, bar charts, 警報
description: Alert palette pushed toward orange. A hexagonal MAGI cluster, a standing unit, a bar chart, and the 警報 marker sit under a command-center header.

title: Clean & polished
description: The most poster-like frame. A large NERV command title, a full-body unit, a stacked MAGI list, and an isometric schematic with telemetry bars.

title: Frosted merged panels
description: Panels join along smooth hex edges with a frosted fill. The NERV mark, a MAGI header, radar, charts, and the system list read as one merged cluster.

title: MAGI status cards
description: Horizontal status cards for MAGI-1 Melchior, MAGI-2 Balthasar, and MAGI-3 Casper, set beside kanji labels for confidentiality, special orders, and alert.

title: Green tactical
description: Military green phosphor on black, framed in orange. Three Eva units — a large central portrait and two supporting plates — sit with radar and waveform readouts under NERV tactical ops.

title: Multi-unit tactical
description: Tactical board for EVA-00, EVA-01, and EVA-02. Active status plates and a synchro readout of 68.4% share an orange and green frame.

title: Entry plug biometrics
description: All-cyan entry-plug medical board. A wireframe head is paired with sync ratio, pulse, heart rate, and body temperature around a central warning.

title: Full-body vitals
description: Full-body vitals wrapped around a central 緊急 WARNING. Pulse waves, temperature, blood, and a sync-ratio plate fill the surrounding cells.

title: MAGI components
description: Playful component stickers on black. Separate colored outlines name MAGI, the supercomputer, Casper, Melchior, and Balthasar.

title: MAGI intercomputer
description: Flat intercomputer diagram. Merged borders connect a MAGI header to gauges, a network node, bars, and readout lists on a black field.
